classification_rules: Affiliation relations require an official publisher-authored source; LinkedIn self-listing alone only corroborates, never establishes, a relation.
Same-name but contextually unrelated persons (Companies House director in Strabane NI; TASS-quoted 'Center' special project lead on uranium) are recorded as rejected leads, not merged.
Historical roles are stored with active=false and published role text preserved exactly.

findings.detail: RUSI people directory lists Gareth Heywood as RUSI Associate Fellow, Military Sciences research group; corroborated by RUSI commentary byline (2023-09-29) and public LinkedIn profile.
findings.name: RUSI Associate Fellow listing

findings.detail: RUSI biography and CELIS Institute conference programme (Oct 2023, listing him in Eindhoven) corroborate Head of Government Relations at Datenna, a Dutch OSINT scale-up; LinkedIn headline corroborates. No Datenna website staff page was located in this pass.
findings.name: Datenna employment

findings.detail: RUSI biography records a prior role as policy consultant for the Leiden Asia Centre on Chinese FDI in European advanced technology companies.
findings.name: Leiden Asia Centre consultancy

findings.detail: Companies House officer 'Gareth HEYWOOD' (director, Leckpatrick Development Association, Strabane NI, resigned 2023-07-28) and a TASS-quoted 'special project lead at the Center' on uranium supply are contextually unrelated same-name individuals; not merged.
findings.name: rejected same-name leads

data.method: Read target and seed records; Brave web discovery on the exact name with board/fellow/advisor/director qualifiers; RUSI people-directory biography extracted; Datenna role corroborated by the CELIS Institute conference programme and LinkedIn; prior consultancy captured from the official biography; same-name Companies House and TASS individuals rejected as different persons; canonical import with Nim merge gate.
data.research_question: Which dark-academia component organizations, companies, government bodies, boards, and advisory groups publicly list Gareth Heywood?
data.termination_reason: research question answered for bounded scope: RUSI (Associate Fellow) is the corroborated dark-academia listing; Datenna (current employer) and Leiden Asia Centre (prior consultancy) are corroborated non-academia listings; residual Datenna staff-page listing left as a minor lead.
